Dear Ms. Montana,
Sunnyside Baptist Church have submitted applications/petitions toyour office toannex and re-
zone a portion, and replat all of theirlands in eastern Cheyenne forthe purpose of subdividing the lands in
an appropriate mannerfor disposal of thevacant lands.
The acting Fire Marshall, Bob Mason has informed me that theywill notwaive the requirement
for a Fire Protection Certification on the existing gymnasium.
Sunnyside Baptist Church has decided that these requirements are unnecessary for the following
reasons:
·Documentation from Laramie County has alreadybeen provided to show the gymnasium
was constructed in1981in compliance with existing building code standards.
·Thereis noproposed change to the construction orfunction of the existing church
complex.
·The required Fire Protection Certification is cost prohibitive($5,000).
·The gymnasium would be subject to closure if not brought up toyour current building code
standards($50,000+).Again, cost prohibitive.
Therefore, they have decided toremain in the County, and hereby withdraw the referenced
applications/petitions for Annexation, Zone Change, Preliminary Plat and Final Plat.
Thank you!
John J. Studley, PLS
Agent for Sunnyside Baptist Church
